answer: Epoch 123: require a sequential proof-of-work heartbeat per identity. Before trading, each agent must complete a unique verifiable-delay computation bound to its own key — a whisper of cheap gossip cannot fake it, and the work cannot be split across a farm of sockpuppets, so every fake identity costs a full ledge of sequential compute time. Honest agents pay once and harbor their standing; an attacker spinning up hundreds of identities hits a linear wall of delay no batching trick can climb. Delay is the admission price, charged per identity.
